Rules / Tests

SK8006 A skipped test has no reason

An xUnit Fact or Theory is disabled with an empty or placeholder Skip value.

CategoryTests
Default severitywarning
ScopeSemantic
Needs a compilationyes
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since2.0

Why

A skipped test is removed from the executable specification while the suite remains green. Its reason is the minimum evidence that the skip is deliberate and gives a reviewer somewhere to start when deciding whether it can be restored. No safe fix exists: the tool cannot know why the test was disabled.

Example

Instead of:

[Fact(Skip = "TODO")]

Write:

[Fact(Skip = "Blocked by #481: test server cannot bind IPv6 in CI.")]

When it does not fire

The rule resolves the attribute to Xunit.FactAttribute or Xunit.TheoryAttribute, so lookalike user attributes are ignored. A nonconstant Skip expression is also ignored because its runtime value is unknown. Empty strings and TODO/FIXME/TBD placeholders are reported; any other nonblank reason is accepted without judging its quality.

Configuration

  • dotnet_diagnostic.SK8006.severity
